clarifications: Target uses centered midrank 2*((rank-.5)/N-.5), so each full date has mean zero
Own and other-industry factor-residual5/21/63 sums plus residualvol are added to all baselines before outcomes to isolate network connections from access to the same residual input
A symmetric correlation score followed by per-row top5 selection need not yield a symmetric adjacency; it is called correlation graph
No missing selected peer residual is silently replaced by zero: a missing contributing peer invalidates the feature row
Future labels may omit incomplete industry outcomes; omissions and exact common model panel are recorded
Statistical associations are not claims of economic supply-chain/ownership edges
